pair_penalty_policy: For every repetition and P, retain the absolute alpha selected from that repetition's independent full-pair training/validation fit. Refit the same descending absolute-alpha path through the selected index on the sampled-pair training design. Never reselect alpha using P, truth, or test data.
pair_sampling_policy: Sample off-diagonal ordered pairs with replacement and redraw them independently at each contributing observation time. Preserve the exact N^{-2} ordered-pair normalization, trapezoidal quadrature, fixed weak tests, and 1/sqrt(200) row scaling.

reporting.primary: All 100 repetitions per P: the immutable existing 20 plus 80 newly declared repetitions.
reporting.independent_replication: Also report the newly declared 80 repetitions separately.

fixed_conditions: Preserve N=1000, T=2, dt=0.005, sigma=0.1, sigma_obs=0, the true kernel, initial law, tests, M=17 hat basis, full-pair validation-selected LASSO penalty, solver settings, independent test trajectories, and rollout policy.
stopping_rule: Run all 80 newly declared triplets at all six pair counts, irrespective of intermediate results. Do not add, remove, or select seeds based on outcomes.
failure_policy: Retain every failed job, unconverged fixed-alpha endpoint, nonfinite endpoint, divergent rollout, and basis-domain excursion. If any planned value for a condition and metric is missing, its all-run mean and interval are null; never average only successful repetitions.
manuscript_instruction: Do not alter existing manuscript prose or figures while running this protocol. After verification, use M=17 only in a six-panel additive figure.
